notes.title: A Year of Direct Contact: A Reflection
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42657749/3394e462f104868639e40381ef03c189911f1254.png[/img]

It’s hard to believe it’s been nearly a year since the launch of [b]Direct Contact[/b]. Let me begin with an [b]apology[/b]. The launch wasn’t the build I [b]dreamed of sharing with you[/b], the community that stood by me through everything. I want to take this opportunity to tell my story of struggle, passion, and perseverance.

When [b]Direct Contact[/b] began, it was just 150 members and me in my small Discord community. Then, overnight, everything changed. The Discord grew to over 1,200 members in less than a day. Within 48 hours, we had 6,500 people joining. Messages, donations, and excitement flooded in. To put yourself in my shoes, imagine this: I’d been working with Unreal Engine since 2017, learning from scratch, failing countless times, and trying again. I wasn’t a big studio its only me ED. I wasn’t someone with decades of experience. I was just an [b]Arma 3 veteran[/b] with over 6,000 hours of gameplay under my belt, 70% of which was spent modding and building [b]communiti[/b]. I loved mil-sim games, and I had a dream to make one of my own.

No one wakes up one day and has the world in their hands. Building something takes years of sacrifice, failure, and learning. In 2021, after four long years of figuring out Unreal Engine, I finally had the knowledge and confidence to start creating. And that’s when [b]Direct Contact[/b] came to life. It wasn’t just a project, it was my passion. And the world responded. Everything exploded after the [b]GLID Gaming[/b] showcase. Thousands of people supported the project, watched our videos, and sent private messages to me. [b]Veterans[/b], [b]police officers[/b], and fans shared their stories with me, stories of war, grief, [b]mental health struggles[/b], and even the loss of loved ones. Suddenly, I wasn’t just a developer. I was someone people [b]looked up to[/b], someone they [b]trusted[/b].

This kind of attention changes you. It forces you to ask yourself: Am I the [b]ALPHA[/b] man, or am I a [b]follower?[/b] When the pressure builds when thousands of people are looking at you, are you ready to step up and [b]lead[/b]? Or do you crumble under the [b]weight[/b]? I knew I had to lead. But let me tell you, it wasn’t easy.

By November 2023, things started to fall apart. After showing the third build of[b] Direct Contact[/b], I discovered a major issue with [b]textures and animations[/b]. The character holding the weapon looked completely [b]wrong[/b]. Thousands of people had already seen it, and I was [b]devastated[/b]. I spent over a week trying to fix the issue, barely sleeping, working 10 to 17 hours a day. With the early access launch set for [b]December 13th[/b], I made the difficult decision to [b]delay[/b]. The feedback from the community was mixed, some were supportive, and others were frustrated. But I kept going.

At one point, I hit a [b]wall[/b]. I was [b]burned out[/b], exhausted, and juggling the demands of my work with raising my [b]five-year-old daughter[/b] during the holiday season. I’d look at her and remind myself why I was doing this. My family supported me, and I pushed through, releasing the game in [b]February[/b]. But when it launched, it was a mess. The response was overwhelming, and [b]criticism came pouring in[/b]. People turned on me overnight, and I had to make tough calls, removing moderators, banning toxic members, and shutting down parts of the community.

Through it all, I kept working. Over the past year, I’ve released almost [b]100 updates.[/b] The game isn’t perfect, it isn’t the [b]masterpiece I dreamed of[/b]. But it’s something I’m [b]proud of[/b]. And I believe it’s something that hundreds of thousands of people will remember, and maybe some even love.

So now, I want to ask you: Are you the [b]ALPHA [/b]man, or are you a [b]follower[/b]? When life throws challenges at you, do you stand tall and face them? Or do you hide in the corner?

For me, the answer is clear. I kept going. I kept working. And I’ll continue to push forward, [b]every single day[/b].

[h2]Looking Ahead[/h2]
As we step into 2025, let’s take a moment to reflect on the world around us. A new president is in office in the United States, and we’re entering a new era. Let’s hope for peace and unity. Let’s work together to build a brighter future, not just for games like [b]Direct Contact[/b], but for the world we live in.

To everyone who supported me, [b]criticized [/b]me, or [b]believed [/b]in me: Thank you. I’ll never forget what this community has done for me. And while [b]Direct Contact[/b] may not be the perfect game, it’s a step toward something great. Who knows, maybe one day, there will be a Direct Contact 2, a game that truly fulfills the vision we all had. Until then, I’ll [u][b]keep working, keep improving, and keep striving to be the best It can be.[/b][/u]

[h3]Here’s to 2025, a golden era. Let’s embrace it, stay focused, and never give up.[/h3]

The timer for weapon malfunctions has been adjusted, resolving issues where the weapon would sometimes prevent aiming or shooting.
[/list][list]
[*] [h3]Weapon Switching Freeze Fix:[/h3]
Addressed a bug where weapon switching would sometimes cause the weapon to freeze, ensuring smoother transitions.
[/list][list]
[*] [h3]Weapon Checks Optimization:[/h3]
Cleaned up internal weapon checks for more optimized handling.
[/list][list]
[*] [h3]Reload Bug Fix:[/h3]
Fixed an issue where reloads would not complete correctly.
[/list][list]
[*] [h3]Hit Sound FX:[/h3]
Added sound effects for when bullets hit your character, improving battlefield feedback.
[/list][list]
[*] [h3]AI Weapon Sound Adjustments:[/h3]
Tweaked AI weapon sounds for improved audibility and better situational awareness during combat.
[/list][list]
[*] [h3]Weapon Animation Sway:[/h3]
Increased the sway in weapon animations by 0.3, adding more realism during movement.
[/list]

[h2]Visual & Performance Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3]Texture Optimization:[/h3]
Downscaled forest and tree textures from 4K to 2K to reduce RAM usage and improve performance.
[/list][list]
[*] [h3]HQ Texture Improvements:[/h3]
Removed high-resolution textures in the HQ area, making it more optimized and easier on RAM without compromising quality.
[/list][list]
[*] [h3]Map Optimization:[/h3]
Significant optimization work across all maps to improve performance and reduce lag.
[/list][list]
[*] [h3]IK Foot Position Rework:[/h3]
Reworked the Inverse Kinematics (IK) for foot positioning, resulting in more natural and realistic character movements.
[/list][list]
[*] [h3]AI Bullet Trace Reduction:[/h3]
Reduced the size of AI bullet traces, making enemy gunfire more precise and balanced.
[/list]

[h2]HQ Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3]Indoor Shooting Range:[/h3]
The HQ now features an indoor shooting range. Press F to activate targets and move them up to 25 meters indoors,  Also visit the new armory at the indoor shooting range.

Improved sandbags in the shooting range for a more immersive training experience.

The HQ has been redesigned to feel more lived-in, with AI characters placed throughout. AI animations are optimized to trigger only when you enter specific zones, reducing unnecessary FPS drops.
[/list]

[h2]Mission System Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3]New Mission System:[/h3]
Players can now accept missions from the Officer’s Desk inside HQ. A new agent supplies high-risk missions with the possibility of earning medals based on performance. The system is still a work in progress but is functional.

Added a front desk in HQ where players can gather information on HQ locations and explore training opportunities.
[/list][list]

You can open your quest log by pressing 0 on your keyboard.

Four new tactical vests have been added to the game, giving players more customization options in tactical scenarios.

notes.title: Enhancing Movement and Staying Committed: An Update on Direct Contact
notes.content:
This update enhances character movement, ensuring a more fluid and enjoyable gameplay experience. I have taken your feedback to heart and have been working diligently to improve the game. Despite the critiques and challenges, I remain committed to my vision and will not give up. While some have suggested that I abandon this dream and want lines for my family, I am determined to prove them wrong.

This project is still a [b]work in progress[/b], and I am committed to making this game the best it can be.

I have also updated the Steam page with new headers for the game. Although we initially rushed the game's release on Steam, I am dedicated to ensuring the visual quality of our Steam page matches the vision we have for the game.

[u]I recommend you uninstall the older version and do a fresh install of this version before jumping in. Additionally, consider removing your save files to start fresh. This step is optional.[/u]

[*] Added the ability for players to swim, expanding the range of environments you can explore and interact with.
[/list]
[h3]Visual Enhancements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed blur and bloom effects to improve visual clarity.
[*] Added a new hit effect for bullet flybys for a more immersive experience.
[/list]
[h3]Underbody System:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Upgraded to a smoother and more responsive underbody system.
[*] The underbody now follows the direction you are moving, providing a more realistic experience. 
[/list]
[h3]Third-Person View:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a third-person view option. Note that this feature is still a work in progress.
[/list]
[h3]Quest/Mission System:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Implemented a comprehensive quest/mission system, allowing for endless mission creation and variety.
[/list]
[h3]Chad Map:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Introduced the new Chad map, located in Africa, for a fresh environment to explore and conquer.
[/list]

[h3]Small Fixes and Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Various small fixes and quality-of-life improvements.
[*] Updated some of the graphics on the Steam page for a more appealing presentation.
[/list]

We hope these updates improve your experience with Direct Contact and we look forward to your feedback. Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Update V0.61.00854
notes.content:
[u][b]Patch Notes,[/b][/u]
We have optimised the HQ,  We are taking a new approach to our HQ as we noticed most people who wrote reviews has less than 30 minutes in the game, we were aware that the HQ was heavy and this means they only went into the HQ and didn't even go into a mission so this is the first thing we had to address.

[u][b]Our assessment and improvements[/b][/u]
We realised it was much bigger than it ever needed to be, 
The trees caused big frame rate drops. and so do the CQB area and the indoor urban training area,  this was causing things such as bad performance and frame drops.

[u][b]Action we have taken[/b][/u] 
So what we have done is we have cut down the HQ by 75%, this means that the area that was not being used for any reason has been taken out, this has improved HQ performance, (We need feedback to be sure this is working, please join our discord, and let us know if we need to make any further adjustments, and frame rates you are getting now) 

We have taken out the CQB training area (This is coming back we are going to break up the HQ into separate areas that can be travelled to, this will dramatically improve the stability of the performance, because having one big persistent HQ right now is not as stable as we would have liked so this is the best course of action we can take at this time)  [u][b]This has not been added yet, but will be in the coming days.[/b][/u]

We have taken out the Indoor urban training area, (this is coming back into the game as an area that can be travelled to like mentioned above this will dramatically improve the performance of the HQ)  [u][b]This has not been added yet, but will be in the coming days.[/b][/u]

In the HQ you will still find the character customisation in the HQ building,  and the weapon customisation at the shooting range. 

The HQ missions such as sanitary duty, and the running course are still in the HQ, 

We have went through everything to find out what caused performance issues and it was 2 sets of trees that we identified, so we have rebuilt the woodland in the HQ. 

We have minimised the number of NPC's in the HQ. 

[u][b]Next upcoming Update[/b][/u]
We will be Brining back the CQB Training area as a location you travel to, this is going to improve the overall performance of the HQ, and these specified areas for training

We will be brining back the Indoor Training area. 

UI improvements and optimisation, here and there when pressing escape button and losing the cursor.

notes.title: Leap Year BIG NEWS
notes.content:
[h2][h1]2024 Intel Briefing[/h1][/h2]

We are delighted to inform you that we are progressing towards our
[h3]“Pre-Alpha" Early Access release.[/h3]

This strategic move aligns with our commitment to enhancing the gaming experience by 
reinvesting into our game Direct Contact.
Considering this development, certain features will be temporarily removed for further refinement 
before the early access launch to reintroduce them in due course. We wish to assure 
you that we value the feedback from our playtesters.

Our forthcoming update introduces a unique form of character customization and a new character 
sets, and many new core mechanics; with these new features that have been expanded, which 
you will have to find out by playing the game


[h2]Why Pre-Alpha?[/h2]

We believe it is imperative to steer our game development in a direction where we can reinvest 
into our game, in which that re-investment into the game will bring the opportunity to 
incorporate numerous features and suggestions put forth by our dedicated playtesters and 
esteemed fans on our Discord platform.

As passionate gamers ourselves, we have always prioritized the integrity of the game and the 
quality of the gaming experience. 
This is why we have consistently declined opportunities with publishers.

The release date for Direct Contact [h3]Early Access is set for the 29th of February.[/h3]

We would like to express our gratitude to our supporters and founders for their unwavering 
support. 
Your faith in us fuels our commitment to delivering an exceptional gaming experience.
Thank you,
ED, Steph, Cody, & The support team.
Mountain 81 Game Productions
